title: MTC Saltö marine technology environment, Karlskrona
description: Marine Technology Center of Sweden (MTC) is building an environment on Saltö in Karlskrona where companies, researchers and entrepreneurs can take marine technology from concept to tests in a relevant sea environment. It has a shared work and innovation space at The Bridge (Saltö Utkik) and The Fishery, a workshop in Saltö harbour for building and developing prototypes; tests at sea are planned but not yet in place. The work is done together with Marinens experimentkontor, run by Sjöstridsskolan, and MTC is inviting companies to take part while the environment is being built.
note: MTC news article of 10 April 2026. The environment is in a build-up phase.

title: FMV Naval Test Ranges (Naval Test Centre, Karlskrona)
description: FMV Test and Evaluation runs naval test ranges for test and evaluation of surface ships, submarines and other vessels, manned or unmanned, and of naval weapon, electronic warfare and sensor systems. Its experts cover shock testing, signatures, hull structures including composite hulls, and weapon systems. The ranges are the Naval Test Centre in Karlskrona and the Sea Range in the Stockholm archipelago, and the Härnösand range is also used; FMV takes on customer projects and invites enquiries.
note: The site sits behind Cloudflare: curl gets the page (200), while Node's fetch gets a 403 challenge page.

title: RISE towing tank (SSPA), Gothenburg
description: Ship model testing in Gothenburg, run by RISE; the former SSPA website now redirects to RISE Maritime. The facilities include a towing tank, a large cavitation tunnel and a seakeeping and manoeuvring basin, used for model tests of ships together with computer simulations. Invest in Gothenburg lists the facilities as open for commercial use.

title: MTC Test Bed at BTH, Karlskrona
description: A test bed that Blekinge Institute of Technology (BTH) is building within Region Blekinge's and BTH's marine technology initiative; it will be part of Innovation Labs BTH. It is to be equipped with software and hardware communication systems and a park of vehicles and sensors for the ocean domain, giving a living test environment used by many actors within MTC, by researchers and in teaching. The project runs from November 2024 to October 2027 and is funded by Region Blekinge.
contact: Project manager Oskar Frånberg, Professor, BTH (contact via the project page; also listed at https://www.mtcos.se/kontakt/)
note: The project page describes the test bed in the future tense and does not say that outside companies can book it today.

title: RISE Cyber Range, Kista
description: A permanent cyber security test bed run by RISE in Kista, where companies and public organisations can test new components in a fully controlled virtual environment to find weaknesses and check that both technology and routines work. It offers training and evaluation in a security-rated environment, security testing of digital products and services, testing of digital twins and support with NIS2 and the Cyber Resilience Act. It is aimed at industry and the public sector, and especially at small and medium-sized companies that lack their own test resources.

title: Sweden Secure Tech Hub (European Digital Innovation Hub for cyber security)
description: A national cyber security innovation hub, designated by the EU as a European Digital Innovation Hub and run by Sweden ICT, a collaboration of six science parks including Blue Science Park in Karlskrona. It helps small and medium-sized tech companies build safer digital products from the design and development stage. The offer includes inspiration and skills development, consulting support, testing opportunities and help finding funding, and much of it is free for companies.
contact: Blue Science Park contact for the hub: Anna Sanderson, anna.sanderson@bluesciencepark.se, +46 (0)70 820 79 10. Main contact: Sakarias Strand, Project Manager, sakarias.strand@kista.com
note: The EU catalogue page https://european-digital-innovation-hubs.ec.europa.eu/edih-catalogue/sweden-secure-tech-hub-sweden-ict also loads and gives the address Campus Gräsvik 2, Karlskrona. The newest news item on the hub's site is from September 2024.

title: Tech Concept Lab and AI Lab Blekinge, Karlskrona
description: Tech Concept Lab is Blue Science Park's non-profit platform for digital innovation, funded by the EU and Region Blekinge, where companies, academia and the public sector explore, test and apply new digital technology with a focus on generative AI. Companies can join free hands-on workshops, get expert and consulting support, and test technology in project test environments such as VPSLx. AI Lab Blekinge, run with Blekinge Institute of Technology and company partners, tests AI in real knowledge work together with organisations in the region.

title: CRATE, FOI's national cyber range for total defence
description: CRATE is the Swedish Defence Research Agency's (FOI) research and exercise facility for cyber security, where large, realistic IT environments, including a simulated internet, are built fully isolated from the outside world. With over 600 servers it can simulate environments of more than 10,000 computers. Organisations can use it to train cyber defence, run large exercises, validate products, systems and architectures, and study attacks and countermeasures; the main facility is in Linköping, it can be reached remotely, and special instances can be accredited for security-classified work.
contact: Jonas Hallberg, Enhetschef (head of unit), Cyberförsvar och ledningsteknik, FOI: jonas.hallberg@foi.se, 08-555 030 00
note: Vinnova's list links an older FOI address, which now redirects to this page (updated 2026-11-09).

title: AI Sweden Technology Infrastructure and AI testbed
description: AI Sweden's technology infrastructure and knowledge environment, where partner organisations from all sectors can test state-of-the-art hardware and develop and test AI solutions in a production-like environment together with AI Sweden's technical experts, using their own data or the available datasets. AI Sweden has run an AI testbed for partner organisations since 2019. Access comes with becoming an AI Sweden partner, and some activities may cost depending on the project.
contact: Mats Nordlund, Director of Research & Innovation, mats.nordlund@ai.se; general enquiries info@ai.se
note: Vinnova lists it as 'Data Factory vid AI Sweden' (https://www.ai.se/en/data-factory); that link now redirects to this page.

title: Printed Electronics Arena (RISE)
description: RISE's development environment and pilot line for printed electronics, where industrial partners can explore and apply printing technologies, functional and conducting polymers and sensors, from lab concept to pilot production. It works closely with the Laboratory of Organic Electronics at Linköping University, and the pilot line is recognised by the EU as a Key Enabling Technology facility. Companies with a product concept or an early-stage challenge are invited to get in touch.
note: Listed by Vinnova as 'PEA Manufacturing'.

title: AstaZero proving ground for automated transport (RISE)
description: RISE's full-scale, independent test environment for automated transport, with test tracks for active safety systems and autonomous technologies for all kinds of vehicles, including an indoor track, a high-speed area, a multilane road and a rural road. It has 4G/5G test networks for mission-critical communication, where robustness under degraded connectivity, data loss and cyber security can be assessed. AstaZero supports customers through the whole verification and validation process, including simulation.
note: Vinnova's link http://www.astazero.com/ redirects to this page.
